freeze_rule: Among variants with path_weight>0, maximize ((mean ROUGE-L at 110)+(mean ROUGE-L at 260))/2 on the 12-dev split; ties: higher 260, then higher 110, then lower mean redundancy, then lexicographically earlier utility name, then smaller path_weight. No-path is a development reference, not a freeze candidate. The frozen variant is scored on the 15-test even if it loses to no-path on development.
